title: プロジェクトデザイン実践(実験)(心理科学)
subtitle: Design Project / Implementing and Operating (Psychological Science)
courseType:
Practical Engineering Education Program
Practical Engineering Education Courses
keywords: Verification process 2.Effectiveness/Acceptability 3.Data handling skills 4.Credibility 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: -To gain skills to verify hypotheses or solution concept with logical approaches. -To understand phenomena, objects and events quantitatively with high credibility. -To reliably find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objects, events. -To deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain basic skills to credibly and smoothly conduct verification activities. -To have an image of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.
advice: The students will learn methodologies required to carry on processes to verify hypotheses; or, the students will learn methodologies to verify the effectiveness/acceptability of a solution concept, or a specific part of the concept. One is that the students will learn the basic“data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting. One is that the students will learn “skills to proceed with verification processes” and “elementary skills of verification activities” from setting the hypothesis to its verification. For “data-handling skills”, students practice the proper psychological research methods (experiment or research by questionnaire) to obtain the data according to its purpose. For “skills to proceed with verification process”, students practice the usability tests based on psychological research methods to reveal any problems of the product or event, and propose their solutions.
requiredKnowledge: Bring your laptop PC each time. You will use your laptop PC for almost all activities of the lecture (experiment, calculating the data, presentation, etc.). Some research might be done for students to get a better understanding of psychological research and for lecturers to investigate any educational effects of the lecture. Whether students participate in the research or not will not affect their grade at all.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts. 2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize information. 3) To find and understand features, characteristics, and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events. 4) To communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly. 5) To smoothly conduct verification activities. 6) To become aware of your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts with guidance. 2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize the information with guidance from the instructor. 3) To find and understand characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, etc., with guidance. 4) To share acquired information to third person. 5) To smoothly conduct verification activities with guidance from the instructor. 6) To recognize your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers with guidance.

lessons.content: Course introduction. Narrowing down project theme.
lessons.assignments: Preparation for determining the project theme.

lessons.content: Determination of the project theme. Consideration of the research plan.
Special lectures on corporate initiatives. Preparation for oral presentation.
lessons.assignments: Data analysis. Preparation for oral presentation.

lessons.content: Overview of the team activities (from research to improvement). Preparation for oral presentation.
Oral presentation. Preparation for final report.
Review on the team activities. Self-evaluation.
